title: On a phone the customer window's representative fields work as on desktop
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer.
  2. Tap the Sales Representative field and tap {Sales-rep-A}.
  3. Tap the + and tap "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  4. Tap the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  5. Save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Edit Customer window shows the Sales Representative field with the + beside it, shown without any hover.
  • Step 2: the same native dropdown opens; after the tap the field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 3: the first field is renamed "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows under it; both read {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 4: the first field reads "Sales Representative" again, holding {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 5: the customer saves and its page shows "Sales Representative" {Sales-rep-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S3-R5: “On a phone, the Edit Customer and New Customer representative fields, their + and remove x work as on a desktop (Story 4), with the same native dropdown (S3-R1).”
  • S4-R7: “Adding Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and shows "Sales Representative - Service Parts" under it. Both start with the person who was in the first field, or "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R11: “Removing Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative" again. It keeps the Service Labor person, who becomes the customer's one representative for labor and parts. A Part Sales field, if added, keeps its choice.”
